static_traits.name: Chen Mingyu
static_traits.family_status: Husband is an Engineer, currently pregnant with a second child
static_traits.social_status: The relationship with her husband is strained by Anxiety about the future; has a supportive husband to confide in
static_traits.medical_history: without similar psychological problems or treatment history in the past; without significant physical illness

basic_info.main_problem: I have been feeling severe Anxiety about future Work prospects. These symptoms started after I learned she is pregnant with a second child.
basic_info.core_demands: Realizing my Anxiety is affecting daily functioning and well-being, which prompts me to seek counseling now. I feel I need professional help to deal with my Anxiety.

core_beliefs: I am not competent enough / insufficient ability
My worth depends on whether I work outside the home and contribute economically

special_situations.event: Learning she is pregnant with a second child
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I am out of the workforce for a long time caring for two children, it will be hard for me to be hired again, which equals failure.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Self-soothing to relieve Anxiety by telling herself 'opportunities will come'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will never have another chance to Work outside the home.

special_situations.event: On waking in the early morning, starting to think about one's own career choices after the children grow up
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot clearly plan a path back to the workplace, it means I will fail and no one will hire me.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Communicates with the husband and seeks emotional comfort and support
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No one will hire someone like me who has been away from the workplace for years.

special_situations.event: Noticing and thinking about gaps on one's resume
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If there is a gap in my resume, employers will see me as incompetent and negate me.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Looks up programs and resources for returning to work to find possibilities

special_situations.event: Thinking she may be unable to contribute financially and worrying about disappointing her family
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot contribute financially, I will disappoint my family, showing I am useless.
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Reducing guilt through self-comfort and receiving affirmation from her husband

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized and to embody one's own worth in both family and career
core_conflict.fear: Fearing Being rejected and judged due to the career break, thus disappointing family
defense_goal: Controlling Anxiety by envisioning worst outcomes and self-soothing, avoiding the pain of Being rejected

object_relations.self_representation: An incompetent job seeker who may not be hired
object_relations.object_representation: Harsh and picky employers/society that negates resume gaps

object_relations.self_representation: A caregiver who may disappoint the family
object_relations.object_representation: A supportive but potentially let-down partner/family

manifestations: Feeling Restricted choices and uncertainty between the family role (Mother of Two children) and the professional self
Waking up in the morning immediately overwhelmed by uncertainty and Fear about the future
Worrying that resume gaps and outdated skills will affect returning to the workplace

positive_force: Has a supportive husband, can communicate and receive encouragement
Notices cases of others successfully returning to the workplace, with a sense of learning and hope
Willing to seek professional help, Good motivation
negative_force: Cognitive biases such as catastrophizing, black-and-white thinking, overgeneralization, and predicting the future
Highly sensitive to uncertainty, with marked ruminative worries in the morning
Self-doubt caused by worrying that resume gaps and outdated skills affect returning to the workplace
Excessively ties self-worth to working outside the home / economic contribution
Anxiety has affected daily functioning and the partner relationship

target_behavior.behavior: Excessive worry and Catastrophizing about future Work prospects (Significant anxiety and helplessness)
antecedent: Thinking about children's future career choices
Seeing or thinking about gaps on the resume / possibly outdated skills
Talking with her husband about Work and the future
target_behavior.core_reason: Interpreting resume gaps and the full-time caregiving role as 'incompetent / no one will hire', with black-and-white and catastrophic predictions about the future
target_behavior.function: Gaining brief control and mental preparation through worry and worst-case prediction, avoiding facing the Anxiety brought by uncertainty
target_behavior.consequence: Ongoing tension and tight stomach, Impaired attention and self-care, marital Relationship tension, Daily functioning declining
